apparel.rule: Apparel may be returned within 30 days of the purchase date. A defective item is accepted inside that window.

electronics.rule: Electronics may be returned within 14 days of the purchase date if unopened, or within 14 days if defective.

office.rule: Office supplies may be returned within 7 days of the purchase date if unopened. Defective office supplies are replaced by the maker, not refunded here.
